product.title: Portretul lui Dorian Gray
product.description: După ce Basil Hallward pictează portretul în mărime naturală al lui Dorian Gray, un tânăr prieten al său, acesta din urmă își exprimă, în fața lordului Henry Wotton, dorința de a rămâne veșnic tânăr. Astfel, Dorian ajunge să ducă o viață dublă, complăcându-se în plăceri interzise și păstrând, pe de altă parte, o aparență de respectabilitate. În acest timp, tânărul din tablou îmbătrânește, pe când modelul lui rămâne neschimbat. Portretul lui Dorian Gray a stârnit la apariție un uriaș scandal. Combinând elementele unui roman gotic cu cele ale prozei franceze decadente, cartea este una dintre cele mai importante creații ale lui Oscar Wilde și unul dintre romanele clasice ale lumii.   Portretul lui Dorian Gray reflectă mult din mine însumi: Basil Hallward este ceea ce cred eu că sunt, lordul Henry – ceea ce crede lumea că sunt, iar Dorian – ceea ce aș vrea să fiu, în alte vremuri, poate. Oscar Wilde   Drama lui Wilde este drama lui Dorian Gray, omul care a căzut pentru că s-a izolat de lumea reală, singura sursă a frumosului căutat o viață întreagă cu atâta înfrigurată și dureroasă stăruință. Dan Grigorescu

# The Picture of Dorian Gray by Oscar Wilde: A Classic Study in Corruption

Dive into the timeless world of **The Picture of Dorian Gray**, one of literature's most scandalous and influential novels. Written by Oscar Wilde, this masterpiece transcends simple fiction, offering a profound meditation on vanity, morality, beauty, and the destructive nature of hedonism. If you are searching for classic gothic literature or decadent prose, this novel is an essential read.

***

## ð About The Picture of Dorian Gray

The story begins when Basil Hallward paints a perfect, natural-sized portrait of his young friend, Dorian Gray. Though renowned for his beauty and charm, Dorian soon expresses a desire: to remain eternally youthful. This wish sets him on a path of double life. While he maintains an impeccable faÃ§ade in society's eyes, Dorian indulges himself in forbidden pleasuresâand the true cost is borne by the portrait itself.

As time passes, the physical model remains flawlessly beautiful and unchanged, while the painted likeness captures every dark secret, every moral lapse, and every corruption of his soul. The resulting scandal has made *The Picture of Dorian Gray* a cornerstone text of world literature.

### ð­ Themes of Identity and Society

Oscar Wildeâs brilliance shines through in the complex philosophical layers of the novel. The characters represent different facets of the self:

*   **Basil Hallward:** Represents the creator, the idealized perception of goodness.
*   **Lord Henry Wotton:** Embodies society itselfâthe cynical voice that defines and critiques appearances.
*   **Dorian Gray:** Symbolizes the human desire for eternal pleasure and beauty untainted by consequence or aging.

The novel profoundly explores what it means to be truly oneself versus how one wishes (or fears) others perceive you to be. It is a dramatic warning about isolating oneself from reality while chasing an elusive form of perfection.

## ð Literary Significance and Style

Combining elements of the Gothic genre with rich, decadent French prose, *The Picture of Dorian Gray* remains a defining work of late Victorian literature. Oscar Wildeâs writing style is witty, highly stylized, and intensely dramatic, making it both thrillingly readable and deeply thought-provoking. This novel invites readers to question the boundaries between art, morality, and decay.

**Is *The Picture of Dorian Gray* considered a Gothic novel?**
Yes, the book incorporates many classic elements of Gothic literature, including themes of decay, mystery, and heightened emotional drama.

**Who is Oscar Wilde?**
